parts.spokenText: A maximum residue limit belongs to a particular substance, commodity and residue definition. It is not derived from toxicity alone. Supervised residue trials under authorized agricultural uses contribute evidence, alongside residue and dietary safety evaluations. A definition can include the parent compound and specified products. Therefore an apple limit cannot simply be transferred to tomatoes, and a parent-only measurement cannot automatically be compared with a broader residue definition. Matching names is insufficient; the measurement basis must match.

The Codex Committee on Pesticide Residues considers recommendations, and the Codex Alimentarius Commission adopts standards.
